# Effektovervåking 2026–2030 {.unnumbered}

Code, cleaned data and yearly result summaries for NINA's monitoring of the
effects of management actions for threatened species and habitat types in
Norway (*Overvåking av effekter av tiltak for trua arter og naturtyper 2026-2030*),
funded by the Norwegian Environment Agency.

This book includes reports for:
- [Åpen grunnlendt kalkmark](Apen-grunnlendt-kalkmark.qmd)
- [Dragehode](Dragehode/Dragehode.qmd)
- [Honningblom](Honningblom/Honningblom.qmd)
- [Elvesandjeger](Elvesandjeger/Elvesandjeger.qmd)
- [Stor elvebreddedderkopp](Stor-elvebreddedderkopp/Stor-elvebreddedderkopp.qmd)
- [Klippeblåvinge]()
- [Prikkrutevinge]()
- [Trønderlav](Tronderlav/Tronderlav.qmd)
- [Eremitt]()
- [Rød skogfrue](Rod-skogfrue/Rod-skogfrue.qmd)
- [Svartkurle](Svartkurle/Svartkurle.qmd)
- [Trøndertorvmose](Trondertorvmose/Trondertorvmose-qmd)
- [Stjernebønnelav]()
- [Askeglye](Askeglye/Askeglye.qmd)
- [Kystlynghei: Methodology](Kystlynghei/report/kystlynghei_methods.qmd)
- [Forest monitoring report](effektovervaking_forests/docs/index.html)

See the [repository README](https://github.com/NINAnor/effektovervaaking-2026-2030)
for the full subproject list and project workflow.

Browse [previous website versions](versions/).
